name: Example: Gulf Coast Pool Marketing
description: A marketing agency that sells websites and online booking to pool service companies. Online booking matters to them, so it carries a little more weight here.

new_website.label: New business website
new_website.pitch: Build a website the business controls, so searchers have somewhere to land besides directory listings.

website_repair.label: Fix broken or insecure website
website_repair.pitch: Fix the specific errors visitors currently run into: failing pages, security warnings, broken links or conflicting details.

lead_capture.label: Contact and quote-request path
lead_capture.pitch: Give visitors a clear, working way to call or request a quote from the site.

booking_automation.label: Online booking & scheduling
booking_automation.pitch: Online scheduling, if they take appointments and want to cut down on phone-only booking.
